svg.title: Provider-aggregatable versus provider-independent address space decided by four scenarios, and the cost of renumbering
svg.desc: Four scenario rows lead to an address decision: a single exit with no public services can use provider-aggregatable space from the ISP; multiple exits with only outbound users can use one aggregatable block per ISP with an independent NAT pool per exit; multiple exits with published services require provider-independent space, at least a /24 for IPv4 and preferably a /48 for IPv6; and any plan to change provider or acquire a company means moving to provider-independent space now. Two preconditions are listed: upstreams must accept the prefix with an explicit filter policy, and the prefix must be aggregatable because many operators filter long prefixes. A side panel prices renumbering - DNS, certificates and SPF records, firewall and ACL policy, VPN and partner allow lists, monitoring, tickets and documentation, and historical logs - as a three to six month cross-department project.
svg.text: Prefix aggregability decides whether inbound is operable at all
Provider-aggregatable space is cheap until you change provider. Provider-independent space costs money until the day you change.
THE DECISION, IN FOUR QUESTIONS
单出口，无对外服务
你的场景
使用 ISP 分配的 PA 地址段
最省事；换运营商=重新编址
多出口，只有内网用户出访
你的场景
每 ISP 一段 PA + 每出口独立 NAT 池
可用；入向不承诺连续
多出口，且有对外发布服务
你的场景
申请 PI（IPv4 至少 /24，IPv6 建议 /48）
入向可控；需双宣告或主备
计划更换运营商或并购
你的场景
现在就上 PI，别等
一次性成本换掉未来项目
PI 的两个前提条件，写进设计里
1. 上游愿意接受你的前缀（双上游需各自同意，且不能只接受“最长匹配”），并明确过滤策略
2. 你的前缀可聚合：拆成很多 /24 会被多数运营商过滤（全局表规模与 /24 过滤策略）
THE COST OF RENUMBERING
换一次运营商 = 一个项目
DNS / 证书 / SPF
全部记录与校验
防火墙 / ACL / 路由策略
逐条核对
VPN 与合作伙伴白名单
对方也要改
监控 / 工单 / 文档
全部基线重录
历史日志与审计
地址对不上
3-6 个月，跨部门
PA 的“便宜”在这里被收回
Both choices are defensible. What is not defensible is choosing PA for a multihomed edge and discovering it during the provider change,
or buying PI while announcing a dozen unaggregatable /24s that half the internet filters out.
Decide by one question: will the public address ever have to outlive the contract? If yes, it is PI space, and the design must say so.
